# HEZQEN

> HEZQEN is a global technology and business intelligence publication by Tinlance. It connects evidence-led reporting, original research and technical analysis across AI & Technology, Cybersecurity, Cloud & Engineering, and Business & Startups.

HEZQEN has three product surfaces: Media, Labs and Intelligence. The current public application includes the publication shell and two engineering calculators. CMS, research and premium capabilities remain subject to the implementation gates documented in the repository.

Important notes:
- Human editors retain approval and publishing authority.
- AI-generated or retrieved content is not verified evidence.
- Payload CMS integration exists, but initial database migration and operational acceptance remain incomplete.
- Do not infer that planned capabilities are available merely because they appear in architecture documents.

## Overview

- [Homepage](https://hezqen.vercel.app/): public application.
- [About](https://hezqen.vercel.app/about): publication mission and publisher.
- [Editorial standards](https://hezqen.vercel.app/editorial-standards): public editorial principles.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/LloydCoder/hezqen/blob/main/README.md): source, setup and implementation status.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/LloydCoder/hezqen/blob/main/docs/README.md): tutorials, how-to guides, explanation and reference.

## Labs

- [VRAM sizing calculator](https://hezqen.vercel.app/labs/vram): first-pass model memory estimate.
- [AI cost calculator](https://hezqen.vercel.app/labs/ai-cost): API and self-hosted monthly cost comparison.
- [VRAM methodology](https://github.com/LloydCoder/hezqen/blob/main/docs/LABS_METHODOLOGY.md): formulas and limitations.
- [AI cost methodology](https://github.com/LloydCoder/hezqen/blob/main/docs/AI_COST_CALCULATOR_METHODOLOGY.md): cost model assumptions and exclusions.
